description: Convert a Steam custom (vanity) profile name — the part after /id/ in a profile URL — into the 17-digit SteamID64 that the player tools need. Requires STEAM_API_KEY. Returns found:false if the name doesn't resolve to a profile.
name: resolve_vanity_url
